verdict.rationale: x402 provides the payment rail that lets autonomous agents pay for resources mid-task without human approval (agentic accounts holding USDC, 'AI agent pays instantly...no signups or approvals required', batch settlement for high-frequency agent loops), which supports background autonomous operation but is not itself a workflow/automation-scheduling platform. Missing for 10: evidence of actual scheduling/orchestration of recurring background tasks, and independent hands-on confirmation of agents running unattended for extended periods without failures.
